# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is an open, interactive textbook on **atomic layer processing**: atomic layer deposition (ALD) and, in later chapters, atomic layer etching (ALE). It is written for graduate students and researchers who already have a background in surface chemistry and want a working, quantitative understanding of these processes.

## How to use this book {.unnumbered}

- **Simulations.** Grey boxes contain small models that run in your browser. Move the sliders and see how the outputs change. Every simulation lists its assumptions underneath. Read them, because knowing where a model fails is as useful as knowing what it predicts.
- **Self-checks.** Blue boxes are ungraded questions. Nothing is recorded.
- **References.** Citations link to the bibliography. Primary literature is preferred over reviews wherever possible.

## Status {.unnumbered}

This book is in early development. Chapters 1 (history of ALD), 2 (ALD fundamentals) and 3 (ligands) are first drafts. Corrections and suggestions are welcome; see the contributor guide in the source repository.
